core: Coronavirus replicase expression and viral genome replication
name: Coronavirus replicase expression and viral genome replication
rationale: Members cover SARS-CoV replicase translation, frameshifting and maturation, viral genome replication and its host regulation, and viral manipulation of host translation and capping; unlike the confusables it lacks RNA editing/APOBEC restriction and centres on replication rather than viral mRNA translation or PKR.

name: Leukotriene and lipoxin synthesis, transport and catabolism
rationale: All members concern 5-lipoxygenase-derived eicosanoids (leukotrienes, lipoxins, 5-HETE) and their omega-oxidation and export, distinguishing it from cytochrome P450 HETE/EET confusables and from leukotriene receptor signalling.

name: Differentiated intestinal epithelial identity and barrier maintenance
rationale: Nearly all members describe the differentiated absorptive intestinal epithelium and its maintenance (one outlier, leukocyte migration), distinguishing it from crypt stem-cell, hepatic/renal HNF4 and antimicrobial confusables.

name: Purine deoxyribonucleoside and deoxyribonucleotide metabolism
rationale: All members concern purine deoxynucleoside/deoxynucleotide metabolism including ADA and PNP defects, unlike confusables covering pyrimidine deoxynucleosides or purine ribonucleotide salvage and catabolism.

name: tRNA modification, aminoacylation and RNA pseudouridylation
rationale: Members cover tRNA base modifications, cytosolic and mitochondrial aminoacylation for translational fidelity and pseudouridine synthesis, unlike confusables centred on tRNA end-processing/splicing or selenocysteine and translation termination.

qualifier: myocyte depolarization and gap-junction electrical coupling
name: Cardiac depolarization and gap-junction electrical coupling in conduction
rationale: Members concern depolarization of atrial, ventricular and AV-node myocytes and electrical coupling through the His-Purkinje system and gap junctions, distinguishing it from SA-node pacemaker/HCN and repolarization-phase confusables.

core: Oxidized LDL signalling and foam cell formation
name: Oxidized LDL signalling, foam cell formation and phospholipid catabolism
rationale: Members concern cellular responses to oxidized lipoproteins, cholesterol storage and foam cell differentiation plus phosphatidylcholine breakdown, unlike confusables on HDL/LDL assembly, clearance, efflux or scavenger receptors.

name: Stalled ribosome rescue and ribosome-associated quality control
rationale: Members cover rescue of stalled ribosomes, no-go and non-stop mRNA decay and RQC degradation of nascent peptides, distinguishing it from NMD/termination, stress granule and degron confusables.

core: Angiogenesis and vascular wall cell regulation
qualifier: endothelial and vascular smooth muscle cells
name: Angiogenesis and vascular endothelial and smooth muscle regulation
rationale: Members cover endothelial VEGF/Tie2/shear-stress signalling, sprouting angiogenesis, vessel morphogenesis and vascular smooth muscle proliferation and phenotypic switching, whereas confusables concern cardiac muscle and heart development.

name: Leading-edge actin severing, depolymerization and protrusion
rationale: Members concern actin filament severing, depolymerization, capping and Arp2/3 restraint at the lamellipodial/pseudopodial leading edge, unlike confusables that promote actin polymerization, ruffling and contraction.

name: Neuroendocrine and pancreatic endocrine cell differentiation
rationale: Members concern differentiation of NEUROG3+ pancreatic endocrine and neuroendocrine cells including adrenal development, unlike confusables on sympathetic/neural crest, neuroblast or early endoderm and pluripotency.

name: NLRP3 and NLRP1 inflammasomes and interleukin-1 processing
rationale: Members concern NLRP3/NLRP1 inflammasome activity and IL-1 precursor processing, distinguishing it from CASP4/5, AIM2 and pyroptosis confusables and from chemokine-production confusables.

name: Tight-junction barrier permeability and mechanical stress responses
rationale: Members combine tight-junction and endothelial/intestinal barrier permeability control with PIEZO1-mediated shear, pressure and membrane mechanoresponses, which junctional confusables lack, while scrambling and eNOS confusables lack the tight junction members.

name: Glucagon, insulin and adiponectin control of glucose homeostasis
rationale: Members concern glucagon-PKA signalling, gluconeogenesis, insulin responsiveness, glucose import and adiponectin, unlike confusables on lipolysis, ChREBP glucose sensing, glycogen/glucokinase or proximal insulin receptor signalling.

name: Tie2 and VEGFR2 signalling restraining sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: Members are Tie2 and VEGFR2 signalling plus negative regulation of endothelial sprouting, migration, proliferation and apoptosis, whereas confusables carry the positive-regulation and VEGF-binding members.

name: Integrin-linked Rap1 and MAPK signal complex assembly
rationale: Members concern Rap1 signalling and p130Cas/GRB2-SOS coupling of integrins to MAPK, unlike confusables on integrin adhesion, platelet GPCR or RAF mutant signalling.

core: Lymphocyte antigen receptor signalling and activation
qualifier: T cell, CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
name: T cell receptor signalling, costimulation and lymphocyte activation
rationale: Members centre on TCR proximal signalling, CD28/CTLA4/BTLA costimulation and T cell activation modules, distinguishing it from thymic selection, germinal-centre B/Tfh and BCR signalling confusables.

name: Viral nucleic acid sensing and IRF3/7-driven interferon induction
rationale: Members cover RIG-I/MDA5, cGAS-STING, endosomal TLR and AIM2 sensing leading to IRF3/7 activation and type I/III interferon production, unlike confusables on downstream IFN receptor signalling, ISG15 or TLR7/8.

name: Neural plate patterning, folding and neuronal fate determination
rationale: All three members concern early neurulation (neural plate regionalization, neural fold formation, neuron fate determination), unlike confusables on neural plate border/HOX or spinal cord dorsoventral patterning.

name: Thymocyte and bone marrow cell number homeostasis
rationale: Members regulate proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis of thymocytes and bone marrow cells to set tissue cell number, unlike confusables on thymic selection, kidney development or B cell differentiation.

qualifier: biogenesis, RISC assembly and miRNA turnover
name: Small RNA biogenesis, RISC assembly and miRNA turnover
rationale: Members cover miRNA/siRNA processing, RISC assembly, silencing and target-directed miRNA decay, unlike confusables on miRNA control of specific transcripts or deadenylation.

name: Keratinocyte migration and epidermal wound re-epithelialization
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte/epithelial migration, focal adhesion and junction turnover and epidermal spreading in wound healing, unlike confusables on wound inflammation, epithelial proliferation or Rho/Rac adhesion restraint.

name: Blood pressure control by eNOS-cGMP vasorelaxation and renin-angiotensin
rationale: Members concern eNOS/NO-cGMP and BH4, vascular smooth muscle tone and the renin-angiotensin system in systemic pressure, which confusables on vasopressin/glomerular filtration and adrenergic signalling lack.

name: Central carbohydrate metabolism and its inborn errors
rationale: Members span glycolysis, gluconeogenesis, glycogen, fructose/galactose and pentose phosphate metabolism with their enzyme deficiencies, unlike confusables on amino sugars/glycosylation, hexose transport/digestion or glucagon signalling.

qualifier: naive/memory B cell proliferation and differentiation
name: Peripheral B cell activation, proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members are B cell signature modules and regulation of B cell proliferation, differentiation and BCR signalling, lacking the germinal-centre, ICOS/Tfh and memory-signature members of the confusables.
